cold_definition: fresh subprocess, copied database, no measured-path warmup; OS page cache is not dropped
warm_definition: same process/database after 5 declared warmups, new session per sample; production opens fresh SQLite connections
contention_definition: 4 valid conditional writers to one absent task, coordinated at BEGIN IMMEDIATE; 1 created and 3 satisfied required
filesystem: same /tmp default TemporaryDirectory as original probe
sqlite: production defaults; PRAGMAs recorded and never changed
percentile: nearest-rank; retain every sample and every error; warmups recorded separately
execution: sequential subprocess samples; no pytest or paid API in parallel; only declared contention uses threads
